qct_n_entry.const: ΔG_n = Σ_{i=1..n}[ΔG_alch_labeled(i)+ΔG_vol(i)+RT ln(i)+ΔG_release(i)] - n RT ln(rho_W_over_C0) + ΔG_outer(XW_n) - nΔG_outer(W)

symmetry_correction.const: Σ_{i=1}^n RT ln(i) ; cumulative for insertion state n is RT ln(n!)

water_outer_signature.const: ΔG_outer(XW_n) = solvent outer free-energy restraint contribution; signed water-outer subtraction is -nΔG_outer(W)

volume_density_identity.const: rho_W_number_per_A3 = water_bulk_concentration_molar * C0 / solution_reference_concentration_molar; rho_W_over_C0 = rho_W_number_per_A3 / C0 = water_bulk_concentration_molar / solution_reference_concentration_molar; ΔG_vol(i) - RT ln(rho_W_over_C0) = -RT ln(rho_W_number_per_A3 * V_eff,i) for each insertion edge i=1..n; Σ_{i=1}^n ΔG_vol(i) - n RT ln(rho_W_over_C0) = -RT Σ_{i=1}^n ln(rho_W_number_per_A3 * V_eff,i)

const.description: non-empty common confidence interval intersection required

extension_policy.const: compute the next n and refit until minimum consecutive ratios and both upper-bound gates pass; unresolved or nondecaying tails fail closed

selection_timing.const: frozen before any production high-n occupancy result

upper_bound_semantics.const: preregistered deterministic modeling ceiling, not a statistical confidence interval
